invariants.rationale: The method returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object and its contract likely expects non-null unless failure is indicated by other means.
The write statuses collection in HoodieWriteMetadata is expected to be initialized.
The size of the returned write statuses list should be non-negative; List.size() is always >= 0.
If HoodieWriteMetadata reports errors, then at least one WriteStatus should indicate an error.
Partition-to-file-IDs mapping should be initialized in HoodieWriteMetadata.
